notes: Dolphin (GameCube and Wii): pkgforge-dev's 'anylinux' repackaging of the Dolphin release, a sharun bundle; the appimage-sharun format handles its /tmp path links and runs it on the image's Turnip.
-b quits when the game stops, so OpenGamepadUI gets the panel back; -e takes the game file.
gui_args: Dolphin's own window (touch screen; Dolphin has no pad-driven UI).

gamepad_profile guide-hotkeys.yaml: hold Guide for L1 load state slot 1, R1 save it, R2 no speed limit (held), Start stop — as keyboard F1-F4, bound in the seeded Hotkeys.ini on Dolphin's XInput2 keyboard. Stop with -b quits Dolphin, the same clean path as Select + Start; save states stay in Dolphin's own folder.

achievements: the player's one RetroAchievements sign-in and Hardcore toggle, written into RetroAchievements.ini [Achievements] at every launch (plan standalone-cheevos). HardcoreEnabled defaults to True in Dolphin: always written.
